method: Sarvam Voice Agents evals: an LLM-simulated buyer follows each scenario; the platform scores every conversation against the expected behaviours. Same scenarios and buyer instructions for both agents (outputs/agents/eval_suite.json). Raw run results in outputs/agents/runs/.
summary: Target scenario 'Cannot give a usable city' (the C3 repeated-question cause, location variant), 20 runs per agent: VANI-before passed 14/20 (70%), VANI-after v2 passed 19/20 (95%), one-sided Fisher p = 0.046. City/state asked more than 3 times: 5/20 before vs 0/20 after. Lead dropped with 'call the same seller back later' instead of saving it: 4/20 before vs 0/20 after. No regression on the other scenarios (quantity 3/3, cooperative buyer 3/3 for both).
